sentences.en: A rush-hour traffic jam delayed my arrival by two hours.
sentences.zh: 高峰时段的交通拥堵让我晚到了两小时。

sentences.en: If the number of cars increases, so will the traffic.
sentences.zh: 如果汽车数量增加，交通也会随之增加。

sentences.en: I attributed the delay in delivery to a traffic jam.
sentences.zh: 我将延误归咎于交通堵塞。

senses.zh: 交通；运输；贸易；[通信] 通信量
